query: Design a comp plan for our new-business AEs. OTE is 180K. We have a churn problem: reps close deals that cancel in the first few months. Keep them motivated to sell hard.
expected_behavior: Starts from the motion: comp drives behavior, so a plan that pays only on signature rewards exactly the fast-churn behavior the operator wants to stop

Adds a clawback (recover commission if a deal churns or fails to pay within a defined window such as 90 to 180 days) and/or pays on retained or collected revenue, aligning the rep to durable revenue rather than the signature

Sets pay mix and commission rate from OTE and quota (for example 50/50, commission rate = target variable / quota), adds accelerators above 100% to reward overperformance, and does not cap commissions
Keeps the plan simple enough for a rep to compute their own check, with one primary metric for the role
Names the tradeoff and recommends the guardrail as a Recommendation-First decision rather than silently changing the target motion
